result.result:
The Kanban board is built and every requirement works in a real browser at 1280px and 375px. The 26 logic tests pass, 24 of the 26 browser tests pass (2 are skipped by design), and the production build is clean. I haven't committed anything.

## How it behaves
- **Layout:** the three columns sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile.
- **Dragging:** mouse drag works immediately. Touch drag needs a 200ms long-press, so ordinary page scrolling still works. Dropping on a card places the dragged card in that card's position.
- **Keyboard:** focus a card and press Alt+←/→ to change column, or Alt+↑/↓ to reorder. Each card also has visible "← To do" and "Doing →" buttons, and focus stays on the card after it moves.
- **WIP limit:** the Doing count shows as "n / 3". Above 3 it turns amber and a warning banner appears.
- **Search and filter:** the title/description search and the priority filter combine. When filtering, counts show as "x of y".
- **Storage:** the board is saved to localStorage under `kanban.board.v1`. Corrupt saved data is ignored rather than crashing the app.

## What I tested and how
- **Logic tests (Vitest, `npm test`, 26 passing):**
  - add, edit and delete;
  - moving between columns, reordering, and edge cases;
  - the WIP limit, overdue rules (today is not overdue, Done is never overdue), and search/filter;
  - saving and loading, including corrupt and throwing storage.
- **Browser tests (Playwright on installed Chrome, `npx playwright test`):** the same 13 scenarios run at 1280px and again at 375px with touch on, 26 in all.
  - **Layout and empty states:** three columns, no horizontal overflow, empty states.
  - **Add and edit:** title validation, Escape and Cancel, optional fields, the three priority label colours, counts.
  - **Delete:** the confirmation dialog, with both Cancel and Delete.
  - **Keyboard moves:** pure-keyboard moves and reorders using Alt+arrows, including that they stop at the edges.
  - **Drag and drop:**
    - **Mouse:** real mouse drags into an empty column, onto a card in another column, and reordering within a column.
    - **Touch:** a touch drag on the mobile profile, simulated with Chrome's touch events (not a physical device).
  - **WIP limit:** the warning appears at 4 cards and clears when the count drops back to 3.
  - **Search and filter:** title and description search, the priority filter, both together, the no-results state, and clearing.
  - **Overdue:** the highlight clears when a card moves to Done.
  - **Reload:** order, fields and deletions survive a reload.
- **Screenshots:** I opened the saved screenshots at both widths and fixed one confusing label (Doing showed "0 of 1 / 3" while filtering).

## Bugs found while testing
- **One test failure:** the within-column reorder test failed once. It was a timing race in my test, since it measured card positions mid-animation. I confirmed separately that reordering works at three different drop positions, then fixed the test.
- **Not tested:** physical touch devices, browsers other than Chrome, and screen readers. There is no automated test for two edge cases: a filter active during a drag, and two open tabs overwriting each other's saved board.

The logic is in `src/board.ts`, with its tests in `src/board.test.ts` and the browser tests in `e2e/kanban.spec.ts`. Run it with `npm run dev` (port 5202).

The "Doing" column is now "In progress", and card titles in Done are struck through (and greyed). The existing tests pass, and I checked the change in a real browser at 1280px and 375px.

## What changed
- **Rename:** the label comes from one place in `src/board.ts`, so the column header, the move buttons ("← In progress", "Done →"), the "Add card to In progress" button and the WIP warning all pick it up.
- **Saved boards:** the internal column id is still `doing`, so a board saved before this change loads with its cards in the renamed column.
- **Strikethrough:** a card's title gets the strikethrough whenever it is in Done, so it applies when the card is added, dragged or moved there, and it comes off when the card moves out. The code is in `CardView` in `src/components.tsx`.

## What I checked
- **Logic tests:** all 26 Vitest tests pass without changes, and `tsc` is clean.
- **Browser tests:** I updated the existing Playwright tests for the new label and added two. Of the 30, 28 pass and 2 are skipped by design (the mouse-drag test on the mobile profile, the touch-drag test on the desktop profile). Everything runs at both 1280px and 375px.
  - **Strikethrough:** in To do and In progress it is off. In Done it is on, including a card added straight to Done, and it is still there after a reload. It comes off when a card moves back out, and goes on when a card moves into Done with the move button.
  - **Rename:** the headings read "To do", "In progress" and "Done". After adding a fourth card, the WIP warning says "4 cards in In progress". The word "Doing" appears nowhere on the page.
  - **Earlier behaviour:** the earlier tests (drag and drop, keyboard moves, search, overdue highlight, delete confirmation and persistence) still pass with the new label.
- **Screenshots:** I opened the 1280px strikethrough screenshot and the 375px WIP-warning screenshot. The 375px strikethrough screenshot wasn't opened; that case is covered only by the browser test, which checks the computed text style.

Multiple boards are in. You can create, rename and delete boards from a switcher, each board has its own three columns and cards, and each card has a "Move to board…" button. The 48 logic tests and 50 of the 52 browser tests pass (2 are skipped by design), and the production build is clean. Nothing is committed.

## How it works
- **Switcher:** a "Board" dropdown plus **New board**, **Rename** and **Delete board** buttons sit under the header. Search and filters reset when you switch boards.
- **Create and rename:** a blank name when creating gives "Board 2", "Board 3" and so on. A blank name when renaming shows an error.
- **Delete:** deleting a board asks for confirmation first and states how many cards go with it. The button is disabled when only one board exists. The active board falls back to the previous one, or the next one if you deleted the first.
- **Move to board…:**
  - **Dialog:** it opens a dialog listing only the other boards, with a column picker that defaults to the card's current column. The card keeps its title, description, due date and priority and goes to the end of that column.
  - **One board only:** the button is disabled with a tooltip.
  - **Other boards:** WIP limits and overdue highlights apply per board.
- **Your existing data:** on first load, the old single-board save becomes the first board, named "My board", with all its cards.
  - **Old entry:** the old saved entry is left untouched as a backup.
  - **Damaged saves:** a damaged saved board is repaired on load.
  - **Active board:** which board you're on survives a reload.
- **Code:** the logic is in `src/workspace.ts`. The two new dialogs are in `src/boardForms.tsx`.

## What I tested and how
- **Logic tests (Vitest, 22 new, 48 total):**
  - **Boards:** creating and renaming, never deleting the last board, and which board becomes active after a delete.
  - **Cards:** moving between boards keeps the card's data, handles an id clash in the destination, and ignores invalid moves.
  - **Saving:** the migration (including that the old entry stays and that a saved workspace takes priority) and repair of damaged data.
- **Browser tests (Playwright on Chrome, at 1280px and 375px):** I ran everything already in the suite plus 11 multi-board scenarios per size.
  - **Migration:** I seeded old-format data (cards in all three columns, an overdue card, a description) and confirmed nothing was lost.
  - **Creating boards:** custom and blank names, a new board starts empty, and boards keep separate cards.
  - **Rename and delete:** rename validation and persistence; delete with Cancel and with confirm, and the last board is protected.
  - **Move to board:** disabled with one board; with two or three boards, only the other boards are listed. It carries the card's data, lands in the chosen column, can be cancelled, and survives a reload.
  - **Per-board state:** the WIP limit is per board, and the switcher selection persists.
  - **Layout:** no overflow at either width.
- **Bug found through the screenshots:** at 375px the switcher dropdown was squeezed to zero width. My first assertions passed anyway. I fixed it, added a test requiring a width of at least 150px, and confirmed in new screenshots.
- **Test fixes:** four existing or new tests broke because of the new button (substring text matching), not because of the app. I made them match card titles exactly.
- **Not tested:** touch drag across boards (not applicable, since cards move between boards through the dialog), physical devices, and browsers other than Chrome.
